FEAT-2-S13.title: Specialty Identification Schema and Contract
FEAT-2-S13.description: Define Pydantic models for specialty identification inputs (user query, filters) and outputs (NUCC codes, classifications, confidence), ensuring compatibility with tool_router and provider search inputs.

FEAT-2-S14.title: Core Specialty Identification Pipeline
FEAT-2-S14.description: Implement dual-pipeline specialty identification logic combining regex matching and vector search in parallel, including AI-driven query expansion and NUCC code aggregation/deduplication.

FEAT-2-S15.title: Specialty Identification API and Facade Integration
FEAT-2-S15.description: Expose specialty identification through find_care_facade and tool_router, enabling LLM tool-use flow to invoke specialty mapping and pass structured results downstream to provider search.

FEAT-2-S16.title: Specialty Identification Testing
FEAT-2-S16.description: Create unit tests for regex, vector, and aggregation logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from user query to NUCC code output through tool_router.
